# The mechanism

## Attention weights the available context

$$
\operatorname{Attention}(Q,K,V) = \operatorname{softmax}\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V
$$

This equation is included to exercise self-contained math in the rendered talk.

## Follow the computation {.dim-previous}

::: {.fragment}
Compare a query with the available keys.
:::

::: {.fragment}

:::
